status: prospective design pending implementation/audit; no fit or new held reference images
scope: Development native learned appearance + matched initial appearance, with native versus continuum motion transport. Not full video reconstruction or untouched-world generalization.
initial_geometry: Known canonical .12x.06x.06m block; neutral gray 1538 unique boundary points

training.loss: isotropic pcd initialization, depth.001/seg1/normal0/aniso0, shdegree3, resolution1; remaining author defaults
training.input: Exactly3 public calibration-camera initial-state RGB-D/bodymasks from procedural material-attached texture. No calibration dynamics or held images supplied.

shared_checkpoint: ONE learned initial appearance checkpoint used by both dynamics methods; avoids attributing appearance initialization differences to physics. This is a controlled common-appearance comparison, not two independent native reconstructions.

transport.native: Unchanged author gs_render_dynamics.rollout, fixed initial K16 relations and each-step K16 interpolation; Gaussian centers/quaternions advected, original scales/opacity/SH retained.
transport.ours: Root gaussian_transport: material-bound Q2 positions, F-offset transport, covariance F Sigma F^T; opacity and original SH coefficients retained unchanged. Known geometry binding disclosed.

evaluation.views: Both fixed held cameras at all26actual dynamic forecast frames; train views also reported separately.
evaluation.metrics: Root frozen render_metrics: global+foreground-union PSNR/SSIM, body IoU, jointly-visible optical depth RMSE, missing-depth/foreground coverage.
evaluation.seal: Generate held physical reference images only after both physics forecasts and all method render arrays committed.
evaluation.descriptive_targets: Physical improvement; foregroundPSNR within2dB and SSIM within.02 native; these are descriptive design targets, not assumed outcomes or tuned gates.

limits: One development object, no cluster-CI superiority inference
Same initial fitted appearance across methods; native binding retained but no full reconstruction replication
Static initial appearance does not demonstrate raw-video inverse learning
Comparison physical state errors and image errors separately; no claim of guaranteed tradeoff
